Briar Matriarch native trial — frozen director specification v1
Director: 01a11c1c-44e8-7c42-b36b-8b50a9c8fb13. Asset/study: matriarch. One subject only.

Baseline: .work/sessions/matriarch-sol-astra-2026-10-08/baseline/author-packet.json, SHA256 be07969a514412ebc8865280bba4c141e00c31d60985cef152e8724a5123be7a; current-matriarch.glb SHA256 97dd27bed0e61d08e8832c080ca29bb103261cd76e18244c878a117db2c43fa0. Inspected side/front/rear/motion clay and side material at 1100px. Baseline measures 163348 triangles, 8220588 bytes, 39 meshes, 3 joints, six-second idle. Those exact captures and original procedural source remain protected.

Physical interpretation and protected identity: living protective bear, lowered watchful broad head, small round ears, shoulder hump carrying forward weight to staggered planted forepaws, descending back and short hind legs, warm umber fur and pale muzzle. Preserve the already continuous whole body, broad fitted face, back/pelvis, paws/claws, support contacts, rump/tail, ear shape and face details. Keep the existing rig and fitted restrained six-second scenting idle. Do not replace sound geometry merely to advertise native authoring.

Observed dominant defect: in side-clay and motion-extreme-clay the broad, nearly horizontal underjaw shelf runs into a steep throat/forechest turn; front-clay shows the same dark slab-like underside below the chin. There is already geometric continuity, but the abrupt large-plane turn weakens the compression of a lowered guardian head into heavy shoulders. Repair the underjaw-to-throat camber and shoulder/neck plane transition while retaining the low head and planted gesture. No wholesale skull, torso or limb reconstruction.

Representation: selectively deform the preserved triangulated continuous skin in native Blender, using broad smooth vertex displacements/shape keys in the throat and proximal neck; keep direct mesh editing, original materials/UVs and skin weights. No detached throat patch, added collar, overlapping tube, indiscriminate remesh, texture concealment or runtime anatomy regeneration. Correct the underside into a short, gently descending, cambered transition into the forechest, with a readable jaw corner and no inflated dewlap. Fit all dependents through the same semantic edit frame. Any central-construction replacement requires a recorded director takeover.

Meaningful native operation: an artist-facing EDIT | Neck assembly with Guard reach control, values 0, 0.5, 1, saved default 0.5. It changes the developed upper neck/throat and carries the skull plus fitted nose, lip/philtrum, eyes and ears together over a restrained approximately 0.04–0.08 model-unit end-to-end head displacement. Smoothly anchor the shoulder root and all skin below the neck influence; paws/claws, rump/tail and back remain fixed. Direct native mesh and shape-key editing remain available beneath this control. The brief must list actual moved skin/facial mesh names and fixed claw probes after import. Anatomical and fitted-dependent geometry, not an unrelated inherited tail control, must move at each adjacent test value and survive save/reload/export. Existing rig/idle remains editable and fits both extremes; no new morph animation promise.

Owned paths: director owns .work/sessions/matriarch-sol-astra-2026-10-08/director/ and, after audited start/director handoff, sequential native ownership of packages/dcc-workbench/subjects/matriarch/source.blend and brief.json. Author subsequently owns those two native files plus author/ frozen candidates, never concurrently. Orchestrator owns registration/integration. Reviewer owns audit/verification/accounting/release operations. Existing sources/publications and nine dirty scaffold paths remain protected; no shared tooling edits, helpers, rate research, commit or publication by director/author.

Delivery limits: maxTriangles 180000 (10.2% headroom above measured 163348), maxBytes 10000000 (21.6% above 8220588), maxJoints 8 (baseline 3; preserve 3 unless demonstrated necessity); embedded dependencies, finite normalized weights, six-second looping skinned delivery. Desktop-first; phone framing/interaction checks do not establish physical-device performance. Imported triangle topology and stylized fur remain declared limitations.

Prototype gate: after exact spec audit and package start, director freezes a separate editable prototype.blend and whole-creature side clay, enlarged throat detail clay, and 1.75-second motion clay captures with exact hashes. The prototype must visibly reduce the shelf/steep-turn defect, preserve the whole gesture, and expose the semantic edit with fitted facial dependents. Prototype is proof of local construction, not a polished whole-asset acceptance. Author continues from a copied source; frozen prototype bytes are never overwritten.

Observable acceptance: matched side/front/rear clay and motion views show a cambered jaw-to-throat-to-forechest progression with no abrupt shelf corner, pinching, dented grid, new seam, inflated dewlap or detached facial pieces. Skull stays below hump, muzzle/ear silhouette remains recognizable, paws/supports and back/rump stay unchanged. Whole/detail/motion captures show the same construction; materials cannot substitute for this proof. Inspect final source and consumer pixels at ordinary/enlarged sizes, animation extremes and phone width. Native edit/save/reload/export and independent five-time source-consumer agreement pass, with fitted dependents and fixed contacts checked; repository/browser scopes reported separately. Reviewer supplies independent pixel clearance before author self-assessment; director supplies exact-byte release acceptance only after independent clearance. User approval remains unrecorded.

Bounded estimate: one unresolved package, 28 working minutes and 450 modeled credits all-in from start for opening prototype (~8min), author completion/export (~7min), independent checks/repair allowance (~9min), final review handoff (~4min). Package hard stop 30min or two failed candidates; asset 90min/1000 credits, including all prior work, with 20min/200credits reserved for frozen final review and closeout. No modeling inside reserve. Estimates are dispatch planning, not a budget reset or quality concession. A failed structural candidate requires director diagnosis before repair. Preserve strongest unfinished result at a limit.

value.verdict: I inspected all10 exact final consumer images: matched side/front/rear clay and materials, motion extreme, enlarged throat,1440px desktop and390px phone. I also opened the exact corrected native source in Blender and inspected fresh whole/detail/frame42 motion clay without saving it. Source, brief, delivery, candidate and evidence hashes rechecked unchanged. The final side and motion silhouettes replace the nearly horizontal underjaw shelf/steep throat turn with a restrained descending cambered arc into the forechest. Whole mass, low broad watchful head, high shoulders, round ears, staggered planted paws, back/rump and warm coat remain coherent. No added dewlap, visible attachment gap, new seam or broken support is evident at normal viewing size. The corrected shared facial-parent operation preserves ear/blink motion and agrees with full-head skin displacement within5.9902e-7 over the tested controls/idle poses.48454protected skin anchor trajectories remain unchanged from baseline; paw/claw movement under the edit is0. Independent native save/reload/export and five-time consumer comparison passed; clearance supplied separately by Sol reviewer. Astra authored the opening local construction and prescribed the bind-frame correction. Sol author implemented that correction and completed export/evidence; Sol reviewer supplied independent clearance. This final judgment is not independent of Astra own construction. Limitations: Tiny inherited/transported triangle shading remains visible at extreme throat enlargement; it does not break the whole contour or read as an attachment seam at ordinary size. Imported triangulated topology and stylized fur remain approximate. 390px phone framing contains the whole asset but presents it small; no optimized mobile delivery or physical-device performance claim. Six-second idle and sampled source-consumer agreement establish the tested behavior, not exhaustive deformation or biological accuracy. Ten omitted triangles are documented repeated-index zero-area importer faces. Art-direction acceptance is not user approval. Full post-promotion repository check and integrated published browser gates remain operations closeout requirements; no claim they have already passed.
